transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

My job says everything is fine, but I know certain people at work are secretly working against me and I can’t be convinced otherwise. They are trying to sabotage my reputation, and no amount of reassurance from management has changed my mind.
Have you experienced any other unusual beliefs or perceptions, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, alongside these feelings of being sabotaged at work?

No, I've never heard any voices or seen things that aren't there; my mind is completely clear. The only issue is what is actually happening at my office, where those specific coworkers are actively manipulating my support tickets to make me look bad.
Can you describe a specific incident where you felt your coworkers sabotaged you, and what evidence you have that supports your belief that this is happening?

Just last week, a ticket I had completely resolved was suddenly reopened with modified notes that made it look like I missed a basic protocol. These kinds of "glitches" only happen to my cases right after those specific guys are on shift, which is clear proof they are logging in to tweak my work. Management claims the system logs are clean, but I know they are doing it to make me look incompetent.
Have you taken any actions or made significant decisions based on your belief that your coworkers are sabotaging you, such as confronting them or changing your work habits in response?

Yes, I've started spending extra hours double-checking my work and documenting every single detail to protect myself from their sabotage. This extra tracking has slowed me down, which unfortunately led my supervisor to mention some minor concerns about my efficiency. It has also created some tension between me and a few of my teammates.

Have you ever considered the possibility that your perceptions of sabotage might be mistaken, or is this something you are absolutely certain about, no matter what evidence or reassurance you receive?

I am absolutely certain about this, and there is no doubt in my mind. No amount of HR reports, clean system logs, or supervisor reassurances can convince me otherwise because I know exactly what I am experiencing. I see the patterns clearly, and I know they are doing this to push me out.
Have you experienced any periods where these beliefs of sabotage were not present, or have they been continuous since you first became aware of them?
No, they have been completely continuous without any breaks. Ever since the company restructuring started a little over a year ago, these worries have been constant every single day.

Have you experienced any other persistent beliefs or fears that you think are being hidden from you or are happening to you, outside of the work context, such as people following you or plotting against you at home or in public?

No, absolutely not. Outside of my job, everything is completely normal, and I don't feel like anyone is following me or plotting against me at home or in public. This issue is strictly limited to those specific coworkers at my office who are trying to sabotage my career.

Can you tell me if you've ever had any other persistent beliefs that you're completely convinced of, but which others, including friends and family, might not agree with or find unusual, outside of the context of your work and these specific coworkers?

No, I don't have any other beliefs like that at all. Outside of my job, my life is completely normal, and my family and friends don't have any concerns about me. This issue is strictly limited to those specific coworkers at my office who are trying to sabotage my career.
